g.text: GDHUB-97 — a stage's text and the goals live in the workflow template

text.tspan: Administrator
/admin/workflow/[id]
Workflow template
goal of the workflow
steps: name, tasks, goal, content (Editor.js)
The workflow's goal and each step's goal: plain text, for the AI only
each step's text: an Editor.js editor (images → Sanity)
Project's workflow
its steps copy the template's name, order and tasks
a step may hold its own goal and text
Administrator
project's workflow editor
Author / team
the project's Workflow path
Open a stage
the project's own text if it has one
else its template step's (by name, then position)
AI curator
the project's own stage goal if it has one, else the template's
the workflow goal from the template
Reset to the template
clears the project's own goal and text, with the rest of its local changes

g.text: A template edit reaches every project on it, old ones too — except a stage the project has its own value for
A project's own goal or text never flows back into the template
A goal belongs to its step, not to a stage name: renaming a stage keeps its goal
Goals are read by the AI curator only; the author sees the stage's text, never a goal
No text is a plain empty line, never an error or an endless skeleton
English only; nothing else in the step changes — name, tasks, conditions, order
Images in a stage's text are uploaded to Sanity through /api/file, never linked from elsewhere
edits the goals and a stage's text

text.tspan: Save — one PUT for the template
an empty steps array is refused
gives a stage its own goal or text
marked as differing from the template
